title: About Abhinaya
body: CMU Abhinaya is Carnegie Mellon University’s premier competitive Indian classical dance team — conveying stories, experiences, and emotions through movement.

title: A Living Tradition
body: Our members train in Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Mohiniyattam, and other classical styles — each born in a different corner of India, each with its own language of rhythm and expression.

title: Stories in Motion
body: Through abhinaya — the art of expression — we bring myth, devotion, and emotion to the stage, carrying centuries-old repertoire to a modern audience.

title: Heritage & Belonging
body: Abhinaya is a space to connect with Indian heritage, build lasting community, and practice wellness through the discipline and joy of dance.

title: Partner With Us
body: Abhinaya is committed to sharing the beauty and depth of Indian classical dance with the CMU community and beyond. We welcome partnerships that support our mission of cultural connection and artistic excellence.

title: Say Hello
body: We’d love to hear from you.
